name: mirage
text:
Understood, and sorry for the wait. I dropped the sharp-book requirement I set earlier and replaced it with yours. The fair odds must now include well-known books: DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, bet365, Fanatics, ESPN Bet, Hard Rock, Pinnacle or Circa. Bets need 2 of them and bids need 1. A company with several sites counts once. Bets or bids built only from books you've never heard of are skipped.
It's on main and tested, but it only reaches the engine when it restarts (about every 6 hours). I can restart it now if you want. Expect fewer orders. I'll watch volume and loosen the bids first if it collapses. It's logged with revert steps.
